instruction: Download the ticket for my flight to Tokyo this weekend from gmail into the "~/downloads" folder of my file system.
notes: Two-app task (gmail + file_system) plus supervisor. The agent logs into gmail, searches the inbox for the Tokyo flight ticket thread, opens the thread and the email to learn the attachment id and the flight details (destination/date), logs into file_system to obtain the file_system access token, and calls gmail.download_attachment with both tokens and a download_to_file_path under ~/downloads. Selection of the right ticket (destination Tokyo, flight date this weekend relative to 2023-05-18) is encoded with static facts ticket-to/ticket-date plus target-location/this-weekend, which supervisor-complete-task checks via the found-ticket knowledge predicate. The ~/downloads directory is created implicitly by the download (explains the file_system.Directory change); no create_directory step is modeled. Only one ticket email is modeled; real data may contain distractor tickets for other destinations/dates that must be skipped by the selection rule.
